# dsh-ui-settings-icons
> **Desktop-focused prerelease `0.1.4-rc.1`:** DSH `0.2.1-rc.1` / `0.2.1-rc.2` only. Fully restart t
he Host and reload the client after changing this plugin. The Web welcome acknowledgement has a know
n configuration conflict and has not passed acceptance.
English | 中文
Release: **v0.1.4-rc.1** (npm tag: `rc`). Desktop verification and known Web limitations are describ
**v0.1.4-rc.1** (npm tag: `rc`). Desktop verification and known Web limitations are described below.
A self-contained DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that enhances the DSH Settings navigation sidebar with c
ustom icon support. It opens a new keyed slot (`settings.section.icon`) for third-party plugins whil
e providing built-in vector icons for known capability packages.
## 0.1.4-rc.1: Desktop qualification for DSH 0.2.1
The development graph is DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`, Cordis `4.0.5`, and Schemastery `3.18.5`. DSH peers are r
estricted to `0.2.1-rc.1 || 0.2.1-rc.2`; future releases are not implicitly qualified.
### Verification scope and known Web limitation
On macOS Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` (build `332895e`), the existing published plugin recovered OpenAI/Anti
gravity icons after a full cold restart. Official uninstall/reinstall contrast restored the original
package/configuration; stock settings saved and retained a font-size change across restart. The rel
ease candidate rendered the full OpenAI SVG and Host version in an isolated Chrome session. These ob
servations do not constitute a full native Desktop acceptance of every candidate interaction or nati
do not constitute a full native Desktop acceptance of every candidate interaction or native updater.
The Web preview welcome acknowledgement fails with `Configuration for "ui-settings-general" is overr
idden by a home patch or command-line overlay`: the replacement composition contains two same-ID row
s and the configuration editor inspects a different row from the Loader. Authentication was not esta
blished as its cause. Desktop deliberately does not register this Web welcome step. This prerelease
accepts the known limitation; it does not disable the confirmation or bypass configuration protectio
n. Host API tests preserve real home/CLI overlay rejection.
### Activation and restart requirement
On the unmodified DSH `0.2.1-rc.1` / `0.2.1-rc.2` Loader, changing an existing entry's package name
can leave its previous Host fiber and browser boot graph active. Therefore an enabled UI-plugin togg
le alone does not establish that this replacement shell is running. After installing, enabling, disa
bling, or removing this replacement, fully restart the DSH Host and reload its page. A page refresh
alone is insufficient when the Host graph is stale. The replacement keeps entry id `ui-settings-gene
ral`; this retains the namespace but does not resolve the Web write conflict described above. Do not
work around the lifecycle problem by adding a second settings shell or renaming this entry.
The client also reads the current Host version from the boot manifest instead of accessing Node's `p
rocess` in the browser. Real SlotCore/Renderer tests cover the `codex-auth` OpenAI icon, keyed overr
ides and removal, and client unload/reload. The optional Host hot-swap regression is deliberately sk
ipped by ordinary `check`; `DSH_VERIFY_HOT_SWAP=1 pnpm test tests/host-patch.integration.spec.ts` ex
poses the unmodified Loader failure. An experimental Loader candidate exposed concurrency defects du
ring review and is not a recommended fix. No Host patch is included in this plugin package.
## 0.1.3-rc.2: DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 adaptation
This published release updated the DSH dependency graph and follows the 0.2 settings shell: Config F
orms, the shared settings shortcut, launcher slot, modal layer, onboarding ownership, desktop update
status, and General rows. The replacement Host entry uses `ui-settings-general` to retain the welco
me namespace; the Web write conflict is documented above. The keyed icon slot remains available. Its
recorded package and tagged-source checks passed; those results do not validate this prerelease or
a live Web/Desktop profile.
## 0.1.3-rc.1: DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 adaptation
Targets DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` and synchronizes the upstream localized accessible name for the settings tr
igger, including icon-only compact mode. English and Chinese regression tests preserve dialog activa
tion and focus restoration.
Moves the development baseline to DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` and aligns the English and Chinese automatic reco
nnection labels with the upstream settings shell. Icon slots, dialog shortcuts, focus restoration, a
nd manual reconnect remain available.
## Features
### Keyed Icon Slot (`settings.section.icon`)

- Declares a new keyed child slot `settings.section.icon` under the settings shell.
- Any third-part
y plugin registering a settings section under `settings.section` can inject its own custom SVG or Re

act icon component keyed by its section `id`.
- Dynamic slot reactivity: icon updates subscribe to t
he SlotCore ledger and re-render without restarting the web interface.
### Built-in Icon Presets and Fallbacks

- Ships with tailored 16x16 vector icons for:
- **`codex-auth`** / **GPT Auth** (OpenAI / ChatGPT lo

go)
- **`antigravity-auth`** (Google Antigravity / Gemini spark logo)
- Stock DSH sections: **`model

s`**, **`agent-presets`**, **`plugins`**
- Gracefully falls back to DSH's standard gear icon (`IconS
ettingsOutline16`) when a section provides no custom icon and matches no preset.
### Full Chrome and Accessibility Parity
- Preserves the DSH settings shell structure and the tested interactions below. Browser visual parit

y still requires local acceptance.
- Supports keyboard navigation (`Escape` closes the dialog and re
stores trigger focus), ARIA dialog attributes (`aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-current`), wid
e/compact sidebar trigger states, current connection recovery/reconnect feedback, and the native con
figuration file launcher (`settings.action` / `open-document`).
## Requirements

- Development target: DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` with a coherent dependency graph.
- Qualified DS

H peers: `0.2.1-rc.1 || 0.2.1-rc.2`; Cordis `^4.0.5` and Schemastery `^3.18.5`.
- Node.js `^22.19.0`
Plugin versions through `0.1.2` target the retired DSH `0.1.1-rc.1` client topology and do not load
ough `0.1.2` target the retired DSH `0.1.1-rc.1` client topology and do not load on `0.1.2-alpha.5`.
